t: Asking for it to move, not to stop
a: اللَّهُمَّ عَلَى ظُهُورِ الْجِبَالِ وَالآكَامِ وَبُطُونِ الأَوْدِيَةِ وَمَنَابِتِ الشَّجَرِ
p: Allāhumma ʿalā ẓuhūri-l-jibāli wa-l-ākāmi wa buṭūni-l-awdiyati wa manābiti-sh-shajar.
m: O Allah, upon the backs of the mountains, the hills, the beds of the valleys and where the trees grow.
